verify.summary: Fresh independent T3 verification passed all exact packaged gates and a verifier-owned disposable API/SQL matrix. Cleanup left zero task databases and run containers.

Fresh adversarial exact-image verification found no admitted material break or operator question. Hostile disposable coverage challenged cross-owner and unknown identifiers, operator/developer edges, missing/random/deactivated/expired sessions, malformed UUID, incompatible/inactive ready, secret-bearing owner failure, protected-value leakage and processing write/claim bypass. evidence_required: .memory-bank/contracts/photo-processing-api.md#per-photo-processing-status RED: no authenticated inventory endpoint returns the exact owner-backed processing projection; GREEN: authorized photographer/operator/developer cases return the exact safe schema and truthful searchable value while missing/revoked session, wrong owner/role, unknown Photo and invalid request map to 401/403/404/422 and owner-read failure to 5xx; decisive comparison: response fields/statuses and database projection match and forbidden internal markers remain absent; artifact: isolated API matrix and redacted marker scan.
purpose: Expose the inventory-owned exact per-Photo processing response over the completed processing projection and existing staff session boundary.
success_outcome: Authorized staff receive the exact safe persisted status/searchable response, while unauthenticated, wrong-owner/role, unknown and invalid requests receive the specified standard failures.
anti_goals: Do not let handlers query/write processing repositories directly, calculate another lifecycle or expose object/model/storage internals.
Do not add Batch status, cross-file polling state, custom error envelopes or new staff roles.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
Direct transport writes or claims in processing repositories
Exposure of credentials, authentication state, model/storage paths, object keys, embeddings, landmarks or traceback
stop_conditions: Exact ownership authorization cannot remain inside inventory through the existing staff principal.
The endpoint would require a new authentication mechanism, public storage route or foreign write.

constraints: GET /api/inventory/photos/{photo_id}/processing uses the existing active staff session.
Photographers may read only immutable uploader-owned Photos; operator/developer follow the one-SPA access contract.
Use disposable principals/Photos, safe repeat and owner-bounded cleanup; return no protected internal values.
invariants: Inventory owns authorization and response assembly; processing owns every state/face transition.
searchable is the derived complete active compatible truth, not status=ready alone.
Standard 401/403/404/422/5xx semantics remain exact and no custom envelope is added.
verification_targets: Exact valid/401/403/404/422/5xx response matrix covers photographer ownership, operator/developer access, all statuses, incompatible/inactive ready and redaction.
Static/integration tracing proves transport and inventory perform no processing write or claim.
